title: A Paid work order's Bill To is locked like an invoiced one
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced and paid in full by customer B, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Hover over the Bill To field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A, with status Paid.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 3:

  • The tooltip reads "Invoiced. Reverse the invoice to change who's billed."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-R1: “When Invoiced, the Bill To field is read-only with M4 as its tooltip.”
  • Terminology: “Open / Invoiced → Open means Estimate, Approved, In Progress, Ready for Review, Complete or Declined. Invoiced means Invoiced or Paid.”
